question:
Choose the correct option:

The researcher’s conclusions were so disputed that they were initially ____ by the academic community.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dismissed**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**dismissed**" is appropriate because the researcher’s conclusions were not accepted or approved by the academic community.
 
• The context of the sentence implies rejection, which aligns with the meaning of "**dismissed**".
